name: Dazodalibep
sort_evidence: Dazodalibep is a CD40L antagonist fusion protein that met its primary endpoint in Phase 3 OASIZ 301 in Sjogren's disease on 2026-09-22 (NCT06245408) and is not in the AMGN book (https://investors.amgen.com/news-releases/news-release-details/amgen-announces-positive-topline-phase-3-results-dazodalibep).
